summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.11/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.11 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 15, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 5¢ higher than a week ago, 11¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.52 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.91) and the highest in Superior ($4.43).
